definitions.explanation: A meeting or gathering of people, often with a warm or communal connotation. Frequently used for informal community events, social gatherings, or club meetings. Slightly softer and more intimate than {集会|しゅうかい}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{集|つど}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧、⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧{好|ず}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{集|つど}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれている→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A gathering of book lovers is held once a month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同窓生|どうそうせい}→同窓生：21773_dousousei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{集|つど}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{旧友|きゅうゆう}→旧友：17475_kyuuyuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{再会|さいかい}→再会：11667_saikai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I reunited with old friends at an alumni gathering after a long time.

notes:
USAGE:
{集|つど}い is the noun form of the verb ⟦{集|つど}う→集う：14591_tsudou⟧ (to gather). It has a warm, communal tone and is often used for social or community events rather than formal meetings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {集|つど}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧ (to attend a gathering)
- {集|つど}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (to hold a gathering)
- ⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{集|つど}い (a gathering of friends/companions)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {集|つど}い: gathering (warm, communal tone)
- ⟦{集会|しゅうかい}→集会：14654_shuukai⟧: assembly (more formal, sometimes political)
- ⟦{会合|かいごう}→会合：02605_kaigou⟧: meeting (business or organizational)
- {寄|よ}り{合|あ}い: informal get-together (neighborhood/community)
